passives.name: Harmony
passives.effects: Grants heal and shield power equal to 0.5% bonus mana.

passives.name: Consonance
passives.effects: Heal the nearest and most wounded allied champion within 900 units for 0.8% of your maximum mana if you or any allied champion you have healed or shielded in the last 3 seconds is in combat with enemy champions (1 second cooldown for triggering the heal).
